Chimap: Magnetic susceptibility map derived from Multi-echo GRE data (MEGRE, VFA or MPM) via quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) reconstruction
DWIff: Fiber fraction map derived from Apparent Fiber Density (not used for NODDI as it models only a single neurite population)
DWIicvf: Intracellular volume fraction (ICVF) map (non-modulated, i.e. not corrected for GM/CSF partial voluming effects)
DWItheta: Polar angle (theta) map representing the smallest polar angle between neurite/fiber orientation and the B0 field
FMW_exrate: Exchange rate map in Free <-> Myelin Water analysis  - MCR model
FW_M0map: Free Water proton density (M0) map  - MCR model
FW_R1map: Free Water longitudinal relaxation rate (R1) map  - MCR model
IAW_R2starmap: Intra-Axonal Water effective transverse relaxation rate (R2*) map  - MCR model
FW_T1map: Free Water longitudinal relaxation time (T1) map - MCR model
FitMask: Mask indicating voxels with successful quantitative parameter fitting
M0map: Proton density (M0) map derived from VFA GRE or MP2RAGE data
M0map_SCR: Proton density map derived from multi-echo VFA
M0map_echo1: Proton density map from first echo of GRE sequence
MP2RAGE_T1w: T1-weighted MP2RAGE image generated from the MP2RAGE sequence
MWFmap: Myelin water fraction map estimated from variable flip angle multi-echo data - MCR model
MW_M0map: Myelin Water proton density (M0) map - MCR model
MW_R2starmap: Myelin Water effective transverse relaxation rate (R2*) map - MCR model
R1map_SCR: Longitudinal relaxation rate (R1) map across echo times MEGRE acquistions (with VFA)
R2starmap_SCR: R2* map across multiple MEGRE acquistions (with VFA)
S0map: Signal extrapolated to TE = 0 from MEGRE imaging
TB1anat_GRE: Relative Transmit field (B1+) map with anatomical acquisition, co-registered to the specific anatomical data of interest space
TB1map_GRE: Relative Transmit field (B1+) map, co-registered to the specific anatomical data of interest space
TB1map_anat: Anatomical image that comes with the transmit field (B1+) map
TB1map_angle: Flip angle map from transmit B1+ field mapping
derivFDir: Fiber direction map from QSIRecon derivatives
derivFOD: Fiber Orientation Distribution map from QSIRecon derivatives
derivICVF: Intracellular volume fraction map from QSIRecon derivatives
ME4Dmag: 4D magnitude image stack from a multi-echo GRE acquisition
ME4Dphase: 4D phase image stack from a multi-echo GRE acquisition
fieldmap: B0 field map representing static magnetic field inhomogeneities - SEPIA
localfmask: Local field mask for susceptibility mapping
meanChimap: Mean susceptibility (QSM) map across multiple MEGRE acquistions (with VFA)
rawINV1: Raw magnitude image of the first MP2RAGE inversion before processing
rawINV2: Raw magnitude image of the second MP2RAGE inversion before processing
rawMEGRE: Raw multi-echo gradient echo images before processing
rawMEVFA: Raw multi-echo variable flip angle (VFA) data before processing
rawMEMPM: Raw multi-echo multi-parametric mapping (MPM) data before processing
rawTB1map_anat: Raw anatomical B1+ mapping data before processing
rawTB1map_famp: Raw flip angle map from B1+ mapping before processing
rawUNIT1: Raw uniform T1-weighted image from MP2RAGE before processing
syntheticT1: Synthetic T1-weighted image calculated from quantitative maps
unwrapped: Phase-unwrapped multi-echo phase image (after eddy current correction if relevant) - SEPIA
